value.displayDescription: Number of prompt tokens processed (input) on an OpenAI model. Applies to PTU, PTU-managed and Pay-as-you-go deployments. To breakdown this metric, you can add a filter or apply splitting by the following dimensions: ModelDeploymentName and ModelName.

Number of tokens generated (output) from an OpenAI model. Applies to PTU, PTU-managed and Pay-as-you-go deployments. To breakdown this metric, you can add a filter or apply splitting by the following dimensions: ModelDeploymentName and ModelName.
